boardRow.name: Relay Rush
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: Four relay sites stand along the familiar ridge chain.

goals: Build across the four relay sites on the ridge chain.
Watch the north, west, and east approaches.
rules: Relay Rush reuses Relay Valley ground.
Four surveyed sites mark the ridge chain.
You stake the second relay ground; the other three want a walk.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
